questions.stem: What ions do acids produce when dissolved in water?
questions.explanation: Acids produce hydrogen ions (H⁺) when dissolved in water. It is the H⁺ ions that give acids their characteristic properties such as sour taste, pH below 7, and turning litmus red.

questions.stem: What type of salt is formed when sulfuric acid reacts with a base?
questions.explanation: Sulfuric acid (H₂SO₄) produces sulfate salts. The acid determines the type of salt formed: hydrochloric acid gives chlorides, sulfuric acid gives sulfates, and nitric acid gives nitrates.
